meta.title: Improve dev server performance and report
meta.body_summary: Add dev server performance optimization configs, benchmark reports, and docs to reduce Langfuse development server startup time from ~53s to estimated 30-35s or lower.

perf_labels.notes: Cursor authored dev-server config/docs with benchmark claims, but no review or comments occurred and PR closed after ~389 days; outcome inferred as stale/inactive.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 822 changed lines across 7 files, this is a medium-sized change by absolute volume, mostly adding documentation and configuration files plus lockfile churn. As a dev-server performance config/docs PR, it is plausible for a small-step performance improvement but closed without merge; likely stale or lack of maintainer interest, with no review recorded.

review_details.concern_detail: No formal review, inline review comments, or PR comments are available in the dataset. The PR remained unmerged and closed after more than a year without any recorded feedback.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduce Langfuse dev server startup from ~53 seconds to estimated 30-35 seconds (or 15-20 seconds with all recommendations applied).
review_details.rejection_signals: No explicit rejection text; PR closed after ~389 days with no review/comment activity, indicating stale or low-priority closure.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Large dev-server optimization config/docs bundle produced by Cursor, but no maintainer interaction or merge occurred; likely stalled due to lack of review engagement or priority, illustrating a process boundary for agent-authored perf PRs.

core_change_summary.description: Add development-server optimization documentation (FAST_DEV_SETUP.md, dev-server-benchmarks.md) and Next.js configuration files (web/next.config.fast-dev.mjs, web/next.config.dev-optimized.mjs) that disable monitoring instruments and expensive webpack optimizations in dev mode; update web/package.json script and pnpm-lock.yaml dependencies.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Documentation and lockfile changes account for a large share of lines; the active configuration changes are in Next.js config files plus a package script.
change_trajectory: Single commit added all optimization configs, benchmark reports, and docs.

No reviewer or bot comments were recorded.
PR closed after ~389 days without merge, apparently due to inactivity or lack of review engagement.
